title: Online Refund/Refund Authorization
applicability: Applies to Merchandise Return (Transaction Type 7) Segment 100 transactions and their reversal/timeout-reversal follow-ups when a merchant participates in the Online Refund/Refund Authorization program.

businessRequirements.title: A merchant participating in the Online Refund/Refund Authorization program must send the Online Refund/Refund Authorization Indicator in Variable Information Table ID 32 Sub Table 11 on a Merchandise Return transaction requesting online authorization; a merchant not wanting online approval must not send it.
The Online Refund/Refund Authorization Indicator value must be 'Y' for Visa, MasterCard, Amex, and Discover.
When the Online Refund/Refund Authorization Indicator is present on a Merchandise Return, it must also be included in the subsequent reversal/follow-up transactions and in Timeout Reversals.

testCases.positive: Participating merchant sends indicator 'Y' on Merchandise Return
negative: Indicator sent by a non-participating merchant

testDataStatus: Segment 100 Merchandise Return (Transaction Type 7) and Variable Information dependencies are documented; dedicated Table ID 32 Sub Table 11 validation is not yet implemented.
